annotations.title: Token Buy and Sell Simulation (Honeypot Test)

description: Replays a real buy and sell of the token on chain state and tells you if you can get out again: buy_succeeded, sell_succeeded, buy and sell tax in percent, honeypot reason, estimated round-trip cost in percent and USD for amount_usd, plus the pools used. Use before buying an unknown token or in a trading bot. EVM chains are simulated; Solana returns status not_simulated with authority and pool checks. No liquidity returns status no_liquidity. Cost excludes LP fees and gas. Price: $0.012 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"token":"0x532f27101965dd16442E59d40670FaF5eBB142E4","chain":"base","amount_usd":100}.

chain.description: base (default), ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, polygon, avalanche or optimism
